_doc: King of the Crater (1v1, 2v2, 3v3): hold the zone. A side with someone inside the zone and nobody of the other side scores a tick; first to score_to_win ticks (3600 = 60 s) wins, or the longer hold at time. The zone moves every zone_move_every ticks through zone_points (fractions of the floor), cracking the floor round its rim when it lands and chipping a cell of the rim every crack_every ticks while it is held. Lives are unlimited like Team Deathmatch (respawn on the pads), but KOs score nothing. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds.
